about: Pass 5.3 Lane S manual field coverage: swarm topology and workload (docker_service, docker_stack, docker_secret, docker_config, docker_node, docker_swarm_init, docker_swarm_node). Docker daemon source citations are paths in the Go module cache under github.com/docker/docker@v28.5.2+incompatible.

engine:ServiceCreate/TaskTemplate/Contai.skip: The daemon drops it when it converts a service spec to swarmkit: containerToGRPC copies only Propagation and NonRecursive of BindOptions (daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:394-408 in docker v28.5.2, the harness engine), so a service cannot use it; TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins this, implement it when that test fails.

The daemon drops it when it converts a service spec to swarmkit: containerToGRPC copies only Propagation and NonRecursive of BindOptions (daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:394-408 in docker v28.5.2, the harness engine), so a service cannot use it; TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins this, implement it when that test fails.

The daemon drops it when it converts a service spec to swarmkit: containerToGRPC copies only Propagation and NonRecursive of BindOptions (daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:394-408 in docker v28.5.2, the harness engine), so a service cannot use it; TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins this, implement it when that test fails.

The daemon never converts Mount.Consistency for services (daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:381-433, docker v28.5.2, has no Consistency), and it only ever affected Docker Desktop for Mac osxfs bind mounts (swagger.yaml Mount.Consistency); TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins it.

Image mounts exist for containers only (CHANGELOG.md v1.48: POST /containers/create supports Mount of type image); the service conversion maps Mount.Type through swarmkit's Mount_MountType enum and rejects other types (daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:389-392), and swarmkit v2.0.0 vendored by docker v28.5.2 has no image type; TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins it.

engine:ServiceCreate/TaskTemplate/Networ.skip: NetworkAttachmentSpec is a read-only spec for non-swarm containers attached to overlay networks (swagger.yaml:4754-4757); the daemon rejects a service with runtime attachment (daemon/cluster/services.go:201 and :308, docker v28.5.2).

engine:ServiceCreate/TaskTemplate/Plugin.skip: PluginSpec is 'Experimental release only' (swagger.yaml:4359) and the daemon refuses runtime plugin unless it runs with --experimental (daemon/cluster/services.go:205-207, docker v28.5.2); it also excludes ContainerSpec, which docker_service always sends (image is required).

engine:SwarmInit/Spec/TaskDefaults/LogDr.skip: The Engine ignores SwarmSpec.TaskDefaults: the daemon's swarm conversion never copies it in either direction (no TaskDefaults anywhere in daemon/cluster, e.g. convert/swarm.go SwarmFromGRPC:14 and MergeSwarmSpecToGRPC:90, docker v28.5.2), so it is neither stored nor returned; the harness run of TestAccSwarmInitP53_spec with task_defaults read it back as null (P5.3-S log).
